### EQ001 — XY and XXZ Hamiltonians

*model definition for both figures and the sign-convention review*

$$
H_{XY}=-\sum_l\{\tfrac a2[(1+\gamma)\sigma_l^x\sigma_{l+1}^x+(1-\gamma)\sigma_l^y\sigma_{l+1}^y]+\sigma_l^z\},\quad H_{XXZ}=-\sum_l(\sigma_l^x\sigma_{l+1}^x+\sigma_l^y\sigma_{l+1}^y+\Delta\sigma_l^z\sigma_{l+1}^z+\lambda\sigma_l^z)
$$

status: `verified` · derived from: `paper Eqs. (2) and (3)`, `periodic nearest-neighbour sums` · source: paper_tex: paper-source/paper.tex:76-86

Numerical form:

```
thermodynamic-limit XY covariance kernel and fixed-magnetization sparse XXZ operator
```

Code: `src/vidal_entanglement/model.py::xy_entropy`, `src/vidal_entanglement/xxx.py`


### EQ002 — Thermodynamic-limit Majorana correlation matrix

*clean-room numerical reduction for the Ising and XX curves*

$$
B_{jk}=\Pi_{k-j},\quad \Pi_l=\begin{pmatrix}0&g_l\\-g_{-l}&0\end{pmatrix},\quad g_l=\frac1{2\pi}\int_0^{2\pi}e^{-il\phi}\frac{a\cos\phi-1-ia\gamma\sin\phi}{|a\cos\phi-1-ia\gamma\sin\phi|}d\phi
$$

status: `verified` · derived from: `Jordan-Wigner Majoranas`, `Fourier and Bogoliubov diagonalization` · source: paper_tex: paper-source/paper.tex:101-139

Numerical form:

```
midpoint Fourier quadrature for g_l followed by a real antisymmetric 2L by 2L Toeplitz matrix
```

Code: `src/vidal_entanglement/model.py::correlation_coefficients`, `src/vidal_entanglement/model.py::block_covariance`


### EQ003 — Entropy from covariance normal modes

*observable for every plotted XY datum*

$$
S_L=\sum_{m=0}^{L-1}H_2((1+\nu_m)/2),\quad H_2(x)=-x\log_2x-(1-x)\log_2(1-x)
$$

status: `verified` · derived from: `EQ002`, `orthogonal normal form of a real antisymmetric covariance matrix`, `tensor-product Gaussian modes` · source: paper_tex: paper-source/paper.tex:141-174

Numerical form:

```
positive eigenvalues of iB_L, clipped only at roundoff, summed with stable binary entropy
```

Code: `src/vidal_entanglement/model.py::entropy_from_covariance`, `src/vidal_entanglement/model.py::xy_entropy`
